title: Terms acceptance record
description: One record for each acceptance of a binding text (AJA-1776). A new acceptance writes a new record. An old record is never changed or deleted by the product. The record keeps the language of the text that the user saw.

terms_id.description: Id of the binding text. Example: terms-of-use.

terms_version.description: Version of the text that was shown. A new text gets a new version.

shown_locale.description: Language of the text on the screen at the moment of acceptance. If the user changed the language during sign-up, this is the last shown language.

user.description: Keycloak subject (sub) of the user who accepted.

accepted_at.description: Moment of acceptance in UTC, ISO 8601.
